ModMetaData.name: DMS 军团指挥官与侦察性能修复 / DMS Legion Commander Perf Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
消除 DMS Legion 指挥官自主性与 AXF12 侦察观察的热点：用 ThingDef 标记集和弱引用 comp 缓存取代每次遍历 comps，以零闭包循环查找 Overseer，并按 Game 缓存侦察管理器。保留自律/非自律机兵与观察地图的原始行为，支持 Waylith 并行预绘制读取，不写存档。
Removes DMS Legion's commander-autonomy and AXF12 observation hot paths: a ThingDef marker set and weak comp cache replace repeated comps walks, allocation-free loops find overseers, and the recon manager is cached per Game. Autonomous/non-autonomous mechs and observed-map removal behaviour are preserved, Waylith parallel pre-draw reads are safe, and nothing is scribed.
